To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the performance effect of post-acquisition international diversification is positive when the acquisition is large, and (b) the performance effect is positive when the target firm belongs to a business group and the acquisition is small.

(i) the performance effect of post-acquisition international diversification is contingent upon the volume of shares acquired, (ii) the performance effect becomes more pronounced for larger acquisitions, and (iii) the performance effect is contingent upon business group affiliation, with business group affiliation moderating the effect of post-acquisitions international diversification on performance.
